pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   B. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. C — Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self-awareness; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Evening Prayer; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
